doc: The comparisons experiments/STATS/paired_errors.py forms for the v2 runs (amendments A7-A14). Models are the runs of configs/arms/v2_grid.json, named as the runs are (<arm lower-cased, underscores dropped>-s<run>; a self-supervised arm's runs <arm>-v2-s<run>: mpm-v2-s<run>, mpmlofo4p-v2-s<run>), each at a checkpoint (A14): best70 (the primary: the first maximum of the reweighted top-1 accuracy within epochs 70-79; self-supervised, the first minimum of the validation loss), wavg (the weight average of epochs 70-79, the robustness check) or bestval (the global first maximum, the sensitivity check); the frozen readouts also at the BatchNorm twins best70_bn and bestval_bn (A14, the BatchNorm rule fired 2026-10-03: the same weights with BatchNorm statistics recomputed on the epoch-80 draw; `twins` names each one's parent, whose training the stream check reads). A frozen readout is the class token (`readouts`' first, a plain name) or the pooled embedding ('<run>@<checkpoint>:pooled', A14), so the two readouts of one checkpoint are two models; every contrast is formed within one readout. `references` are models outside the grid, kept apart and in no contrast: the untrained trunk of run index k (A14's frozen reference row), init-s<k>@init. Every contrast is formed at each checkpoint, and run k of one arm is paired with run k of another only where their training streams agree up to that checkpoint (A7). Every ratio is coarse over fine: above 1 = the coarser, merged, unseen or control side is worse. Every contrast is also formed between the checkpoints (wavg/best70 and bestval/best70) and labelled by the A14 rule. small_sample_rule: the A14 small-sample errors (two runs: the error is never below the observed spread, at one degree of freedom; one run pair: not computed). A new arm needs its grid entry and one line here; labels are optional (the arm name stands in). An arm decided but not yet in the grid is listed under pending_arms, and its contrasts form no row until it is; an arm named here that is neither is fatal.

INIT.note: the untrained trunk of run index k (init_trunk.pt, identical across vocabularies by A7), extracted as init-s<k> (scripts/build_extract_jobs.py v2_init_refs); A14's frozen reference row

labels.FLAV_F1: F0 with the four-prong b/c cut (F1)
labels.FLAV_F1R: F1 with a random four-prong cut (F1r)

contrasts.note: secondary reading: the joint fit with one term per axis in each partition's realised dose of the probe pair's axis, the pair's own classes left out (axis_doses)
P2 extended: F1 beats F1r on b vs c in two-prong decays; on the four-prong probe, the manipulation check (F1 splits bbqq/ccqq, F1r merges it)
descriptive; P2 (c), the paired equivalence of F0 and the 17-class model, is read in p2
